title: The rational compact-support stage morphism
statement: With prime l, finite-field datum D, l != D.p, X and Y finite-type over D.k, a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f, coefficient construction P for the lifted PadicAlgCl and compactification c, there is a StageAction. Its stage functors are exactly P.ring.operation at rational finiteField E, and its transition isomorphisms are exactly P.fields.rationalComparison along the actual coefficient inclusions of unlifted PadicAlgCl.

source.place: Sections 6.7–6.8, especially Definition 6.7.6, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; agent decomposition of lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-realization

proof.text: Use literal transition and associator records for the source and target stage systems. The uniqueness specification of stageSystem identifies these records with the published systems. Take the P rational functor at each stage and q at every coefficient inclusion. The normalized rational left composition law gives the morphism coherence equation. Identify the composite algebra homomorphism with coefficientInclusion along the transitive relation; this removes the equality transport in the normalized associator. Transport the resulting morphism along the two whole-system equalities; its functors and q remain heterogeneously equal to the original specified data.

proof_origin.place: The existing native compact-support realization plan, separated into native geometry, rational stage action, finite-stage comparison, and common-stage descent.
